invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of getDependencyAssetDescriptors, which should produce a non-null Array.
The FileHandle tmxFile is used for parsing and passed into another method, so it should not be null.
fileName is used to identify resources; a null value may not be valid input.
If the parameter is non-null, its generateMipMaps field is copied to textureParameter.genMipMaps before being passed onward.
An Array's size should never be negative.
